pk.context: 600 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: An oxazolidinone antibacterial with about 100% oral bioavailability, so oral and IV dosing need no adjustment.

clues.text: Absolute bioavailability is about 100%, and meals need not be timed around doses. About 31% is protein bound, and nonrenal clearance accounts for about 65% of total clearance.
The active moiety has a molecular weight of 337.35.
Approved under an NDA as 600 mg tablets, a 100 mg per 5 mL oral suspension, and intravenous bags, dosed every 12 hours.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated with hypersensitivity to the drug and with monoamine oxidase inhibitors, or within two weeks of one.
Pneumonia (nosocomial or community-acquired), skin and skin structure infections, and vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium infections, caused by susceptible Gram-positive bacteria.
The label describes it only as an antibacterial drug of the oxazolidinone class.
The generic name begins with L and has nine letters.
